en_US.title: Ecology Scan Evidence Brief
en_US.scanner: Ecology anchors qualify when they change sound, route safety, resource handling, or Atlas-contamination suspicion.
en_US.terminal: PLACE ECOLOGY: photic mat oxygen risk, glass grazer clearing, lantern false-safe, brine vane current marker, sensor-tagged fauna route echo.
en_US.audio: Scan rule: the creature is good content only if it changes what the player does next.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Ecology behaves as route grammar. A scan card earns its codex entry through a physical decision.
en_US.external_site: Public ecology articles should show beauty under pressure and the later intrusion of Atlas repair logic.
en_US.field_note: Ecology anchors belong by decision pressure, not species checklist. Absence, sound, and route deformation can matter before a full reveal.

en_US.scanner: Terminal promotion is reserved for first-hour orders, legal contradictions, receiver choices, and proof chains.
en_US.terminal: PROMOTE TERMINAL: if it changes immediate action, proves a lie, opens a route, or alters ending custody. Otherwise keep it as NarrativeDiscovery.
en_US.audio: Operator rule: hardware space is a claim. Do not spend it on decoration.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Terminal slots stay diegetic and useful. The backlog can hold codex facts; real terminals must affect a decision.
en_US.external_site: HECTON-8 terminals are instruments and records, not lore dump billboards.
en_US.field_note: A terminal slot is spent only when the record changes immediate action, proves a lie, opens a route, or alters ending custody.
